title: Jack Rabbit Rachael Rabbit Lemon, Pear and Raspberry Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: This incredibly well-balanced e-liquid from Rachael Rabbit is a delightful fusion of sharp and zesty lemon, with sharp, tangy raspberry and the mellow sweetness of fresh pear. A truly essential vape for fruit lovers. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
